name: io.github.1shizaan/debugai-mcp
description: DebugAI MCP server. One command sets it up in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Zed, Windsurf, Cline or any MCP client: browser sign-in, no key pasting, no config editing.

environmentVariables.description: Your DebugAI API key (dbg_...). Optional: run `npx -y @debugai/mcp setup` for browser sign-in instead, no key needed.
environmentVariables.name: DEBUGAI_API_KEY
